note: Generated by tools/switch-census.mjs. `verdict` is written by hand: what a mod can do about this dispatch. `kind` is SWITCH, IF_CHAIN (an if/else chain of >= threshold arms over one discriminant) or ARRAY_LOOKUP (a module-level const array of >= threshold elements, indexed dynamically) - three syntactic shapes that are equally closed to a mod.
